note: Real-user readiness for the 6 foreign testers: (1) Feedback button (bottom-left) storing to Cloudflare KV with device info and recent JS errors - foreign users never email you, so they need a zero-friction way to report problems; (2) first-run onboarding explaining what each tab does and how Score works (tap Score, speak, tap Stop); (3) privacy note on the scene view - Europeans are GDPR-sensitive and will not grant mic access without knowing recordings are not stored; (4) microphone-blocked help with per-browser recovery steps (WeChat / iOS Safari / Chrome), since a denied mic silently kills the core feature; (5) global error capture so crashes are reported with feedback. Also fixed: APP_VERSION was stuck at 0.3.2 while version.json was 0.3.7, which made the 'new version available' toast fire on every single load.
